text:
Support: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting 5xx / timeouts on hosted inference since ~08:12 UTC. Error spike on /v1/generate. Sample req_ids: req_a1b2, req_c3d4. Affected: Acme, Fable, one internal QA run.
Maya S: Oncall here, thx. Can eng-runtime pick this up? @Ravi K can you take initial triage?
Ravi K: Got it. Checking traces now. Any recent deploys or routing changes around 08:00?
Ben L: Noticed a config push to gateway routing at 08:00 — increased parallel fanout to backend pools for prom throughput tests.
Irene Q: I see auth-proxy error rates jumping at 08:11, auth latency p95 went from 20ms -> 800ms. Many upstream 502/504s at the gateway.
Ben L: Logs: ```
[08:14:22] gateway: upstream 502 for req=req_a1b2 route=/v1/generate
[08:14:23] auth-proxy: 429 throttle token=acct_123
[08:14:24] gateway: retrying request req_a1b2 -> fanout x3
```
Maya S: Immediate mitigation ideas? Can we reduce fanout or enable circuit-breaker?
Irene Q: I can roll routing change back to previous config (pre-08:00) and throttle gateway concurrency for /v1/generate. Doing rollback now.
OpsBot: rollback-deploy: routing-config reverted (id: rc-2026-prev) — success.
Maya S: Confirming traffic shift to fallback pool. Observability: 5xx rate dropped ~78% in 10m. Still seeing occasional 504s.
Ravi K: Repro steps I ran locally: `for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer token_acct_123" -X POST https://hosted.redwood/api/v1/generate & done` -> p99 ~2.3s, some 504s in concurrent burst. Auth-proxy logs show bursts of KV lookups failing.
Ben L: Hypothesis: the routing fanout increased concurrent auth checks which overloaded auth-cache -> auth latency -> gateway timeouts and retries amplify load. Also our retry policy has aggressive immediate retries.
Maya S: Agreed. Short-term: 1) keep reverted routing 2) reduce gateway per-route concurrency 3) add short delay to retry policy (linear backoff). Proceeding with #2 and #3.
Irene Q: Concurrency cap applied to /v1/generate (cap=30). Retry policy updated to backoff=100ms -> enabled.
OpsBot: config-update: gateway-concurrency (/v1/generate)=30 applied.
Maya S: Monitoring shows further drop, error rate ~90% lower than peak, customer impact largely mitigated.
Elena P: Sending customer comms: initial ack + ETA for full root cause follow-up.
Support Bot: Ticket INC-2026 created and linked to this thread.
Maya S: Next steps (owners):
- Action A: Increase auth cache TTL and add soft circuit-breaker on auth-proxy (owner: Ravi K, due: 48h)
- Action B: Harden gateway retry policy to avoid retry fanout (owner: Ben L, due: 72h)
- Action C: Add end-to-end synthetic tests for auth-backed endpoints at q1m cadence (owner: Irene Q, due: 24h)
- Action D: Improve alerting thresholds for auth latency and pre-5xx slope (owner: Elena P / Observability, due: 24h)
Maya S: Please paste PR links & runbooks here when ready. We'll also draft a short postmortem template for customers.
Ravi K: Created PR to bump auth cache TTL + circuit-breaker: https://git.company/r/redwood/auth-proxy/pull/312 - tests passing in staging.
Ben L: PR to adjust retry/backoff + add telemetry: https://git.company/r/redwood/gateway/pull/789 - canary scheduled for 09:30 UTC tomorrow.
Irene Q: Added synthetic job to infra scheduler: job id syn-auth-98, first run in 5m. Dashboard panels updated.
Elena P: Customer emails queued, offering credits for impacted windows, cc'd legal.
Maya S: War room summary (short): cause = routing fanout + auth-cache contention -> auth latency -> gateway timeouts amplified by immediate retries. Mitigation = rollback routing + limit concurrency + backoff.
Maya S: Closing war room now. Will reopen if new alerts surface. Postmortem to be published after action items complete.

-- 19h later --
Elena P: Postmortem draft: completed. Summary + timeline + RCA + actions. Sharing link: https://internal/docs/postmortems/3916001110-inference-throttle-pm. Please review.
Ravi K: Implemented auth-proxy circuit-breaker in prod and increased cache TTL. Deployed and monitoring stable.
Ben L: Gateway retry policy change canary healthy, rolling to all regions.
Irene Q: Synthetic job caught a regression in staging yesterday, prevented a potential re-introduction.
Elena P: Customers notified with final report and credits applied. No outstanding escalations.
Maya S: Great work team. Action items tracked in Jira: RD-INC-391600. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
